description: An evaluator now looks like this: the whole evaluator (4, third rule), pending until the server acknowledges it (5), and with what of it waits out an undo window marked removing.

book.description: The book the evaluator is kept with.

description.description: What the evaluator checks, in the user's words, shown under its name and read by the chat to choose an evaluator; empty for none. Your values has a fixed one.

journal.description: Listed in the journal's Evaluators as well as its own book's ("Show in journal"); false when absent.

on.description: The question is switched on or off: a question switched off is kept but not asked. On when absent.

kind.description: yesno: a yes / no question. pick: one of the options is picked.

name.description: A short name of what the question is about, such as a value's name for a question of Your values; absent when the question has none.

yes.description: What yes means, for a yesno question; empty for none.

no.description: What no means, for a yesno question; empty for none.

options.description: The options of a pick question; kept while the question is yesno, so switching back loses nothing.

items.description: One option of a pick question.

name.description: The option as the user sees it.

description.description: What the option means; empty for none.

removing.description: The option waits out its undo window (removal.started).

icon.description: The icon the option's mark gets on a choice point line, by its name in the icons (7.6); absent for none, so the mark is a check, or a warning when the option is not the one expected.

against.description: Picking this option counts against what the question asks about (Goes against), which makes a combined mark red. False when absent.

removing.description: The question waits out its undo window (removal.started).

expect.description: The answer expected: an option's id for a pick question, or yes or no for a yes / no question; absent when none is expected. A choice point mark is green when Jev gives it, red when not, uncoloured when absent.

position.description: The evaluator's place in the list: a key that sorts by plain comparison, the list in ascending order (5).

updatedAt.description: When the evaluator's content last changed, as an ISO time; absent on one kept from before it was recorded, which counts as the oldest.

pending.description: A change the server has not acknowledged yet (5).

removing.description: The evaluator waits out its undo window (removal.started).

starterFor.description: The try pages (8) whose new guests get a copy of this evaluator, by name, such as "evaluators"; empty or absent for none. Only the admin's evaluators carry it.

derivedFrom.description: Built by this fact from another one rather than written by the user: values, the client's values (Your values, one question per value). Its questions cannot be changed in the evaluator editor, only where they come from, and it cannot be deleted; its on/off and its place in the list are the user's. Absent for an evaluator the user wrote.

combined.description: Its answers about a line are shown as one mark: green when any question got its expected answer; otherwise red when any question got an option marked against; otherwise grey. False when absent: a mark per shown answer.
